gates.G1: image<->BCP dex-checksum consistency: parse each boot-<jar>.vdex kChecksumSection (version 027); compare candidate vs reference per segment; a differing segment not in swap_jars = reject. Replicates the board runtime's load-time checksum verification, offline.
gates.G2: compiled-code suspend-check shape: oatdump a loop-bearing probe (java.lang.String#hashCode) from candidate and reference, compare normalized instruction sequence (absolute addresses stripped). Difference = reject. Distinguishes implicit `ldr xN,[xN]` (T5b) from explicit `ldr w16,[tr];tst;bl pTestSuspend` (T5c/v3c).
gates.skipped_is_fail: if swap_image or swap_jars (compiled code changes), G2 is REQUIRED; oatdump unavailable => G2=FAIL, not SKIPPED. G2 may be skipped only when changes_compiled_code=false.
